title: Auto Tap and Auto Collect and Auto tree and more
features:
⚡ Auto Tap
   Fast tree tapping for maximum wood collection

🌳 Auto Hit Tree
   Automatically chops mutation trees on your plot

💰 Auto Collect Coins
   Instantly teleports all coins to you

👑 Auto Prestige
   Auto-prestiges when requirements are met

💧 Auto Use Cans
   Waters your tree using inventory cans

🪣 Auto Pickup Cans
   Picks up watering cans from ground

🎯 Water Threshold (1-100)
   Minimum can level required to trigger auto-water

⚗️ Auto Claim Purifier
   Automatically claims water purifier rewards

🔧 Auto Fill Purifier
   Fills purifier with lowest level cans

🔥 Auto Steal Cans
   Steals watering cans from other players' plots

🚀 Speed Hack
   Increases your walk speed

⚙️ Walk Speed (16-200)
   Adjust movement speed value
